terminal.emulator: direct PTY with deterministic loopback HTTP/SSE completed tool-call fixture

reference.capture: fresh synthetic-home Hermes TUI process with one ordinary prompt, a complete clarify tool-call stream, and a bounded post-completion observation window

normalization: The reference checkout, synthetic HOME/HERMES_HOME paths, prompt text, assistant text, tool arguments, credentials, authorization values, session identifiers, timestamps, and redraw bytes are omitted or represented by stable markers or digests.

The provider is a deterministic 127.0.0.1 fixture owned by the probe; all recorded HTTP traffic stayed on that loopback endpoint and no external network, OAuth flow, browser, tool response, or user credential was used.

The response retains OpenAI-compatible tool-call delta shape and argument-fragment lengths/digests without copying argument payloads; the [DONE] marker completes the stream so the post-completion handoff can be observed.
clarify is interactive-only; observing its TUI question surface involves no external side effect and does not turn the reference handoff into Hades execution behavior.
Follow-up request shapes are recorded as role/tool-call-presence markers only; message contents and tool results are never persisted.

steps.precondition: Fresh Hermes TUI at 120x40 with an isolated synthetic HERMES_HOME and a configured custom provider at the probe-owned loopback endpoint.

side_effect_boundary.credentials: none; only a synthetic key was placed in the throwaway config and auth values were reduced to presence booleans
side_effect_boundary.external_network: none observed; all recorded HTTP traffic stayed on the synthetic loopback
side_effect_boundary.filesystem: reference runtime state was confined to the throwaway HOME/HERMES_HOME and removed after the probe; no tool-specific path or result was observed
side_effect_boundary.tool_action: clarify is interactive-only; its execution is confined to the TUI question surface and no external side effect was observed

unknowns: Whether the observed post-completion surface is stable across reference restarts, and the exact completion/approval/failure semantics, remain intentionally bounded by this single fresh observation.
Provider-specific retries, malformed or truncated argument handling, multiple calls, approval policy, tool results, and post-handoff failure behavior remain unknown.
How the clarify tool result message was populated without an explicit answer typed in the bounded window, and whether the visible question surface accepts interaction, remain unclassified details.
